done.why: I had a short taste, solved the sailor greeting, and drank the vial, which may have wasted something. I stopped there.

about: An underground-cavern adventure. You wake at the foot of an endless stair after a dream where an old man calls this the final test. You explore dark caverns, a shadowy land and an underground sea. Something unseen follows you, and a sailor wants a particular greeting.

moments.note: Footsteps keep pace with me and wait when I hold my breath.
The sailor hints at what he wants to hear, and the classic greeting worked.
I drank the vial's contents with no effect. It may have been needed for something else.

wished: Pour the vial's liquid on the sword or the rock.
Find out who is following me in the shadows.

lines.line: They are keeping your pace, and when you hold your breath to hear them better, they wait too.
as though he were waiting for something in particular and this was not quite it.
lines.why: A clever hint that nudges the player without giving the answer.

fun.why: A short session with a nice puzzle, but it ended early.

engagement.why: The footsteps and the sailor drew me in.

difficulty.why: The hints were clear and the puzzle was easy.

interestingness.why: It has a mysterious follower and a sword in a rock.

prose.why: The prose is atmospheric and the hints are well worded.
